newsitem.title: ITALY: Autostrade plans to be approved today-minister.
newsitem.headline: Autostrade plans to be approved today-minister.

text.p: The board of Autostrade will approve outline privatisation plans today and the Public Works Ministry will send them to the council of state, the final stage before privatisation, minister Paolo Costa said.
"By this evening, the ministry will send the outline privatisation plans to the council of state," Costa told reporters.

The council of state, which is Italy's highest consultative body for judicial and administrative affairs, has 45 days to examine the sell-off plans for the motorway manager but ministry sources said it would take far less time.

Pietro Ciucci, director general of state industrial holding company Iri said earlier this month that the group intended to create a stable core group of shareholders by the end of June and then launch a public share offer (OPV) in September.
